snc.text: Kamiz joined the Obscura and rose to run the whole network, and Raffine summoned her to the Cloud Spire to say that someone had attacked the visionaries and that Kamiz must find who sent the vision.
Kamiz and Queza traced a warehouse explosion in the Mezzio to a reporter, Lacey Lanine, who was later found in a dumpster with her mind wiped, and Kamiz rescued Tivit when his shop was set aflame.
Kamiz removed Queza from the case after a clash, then told Raffine the visions were not what they seemed, since the Cloud Spire has no halos.
Kamiz and Queza trapped Lagrella with a mirror and forced her to nullify Lacey's contract, restoring Lacey's memory, and Kamiz admitted that maybe she did not know everything.
